title: FogTTA: Online Test-Time Adaptation for Robust Transformer-based Object Detection in Foggy Weather
abstract: arXiv:2610.29618v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Object detection models for autonomous driving commonly experience substantial performance drops when deployed under adverse weather due to the domain shift between training data and real-world operating conditions. This degradation is especially evident when models trained on clear-weather images encounter foggy environments with reduced visibility and contrast. To address this challenge, we introduce FogTTA, an online test-time adaptation framework designed to improve the robustness of Transformer-based object detectors in fog. Using RF-DETR as the underlying object detector, FogTTA enables real-time adaptation to the streaming target domain without requiring source data or retraining. The framework follows a teacher-student design, where the deployed model serves as the teacher and generates pseudo labels from weakly augmented target inputs. translated_title: FogTTA：面向雾天鲁棒Transformer目标检测的在线测试时自适应
translated_abstract: 自动驾驶中的目标检测模型在恶劣天气下部署时，由于训练数据与真实运行条件之间的域偏移，通常会出现显著的性能下降。当在晴天图像上训练的模型遇到能见度和对比度降低的雾天环境时，这种性能下降尤为明显。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了FogTTA，这是一个旨在提升基于Transformer的目标检测器在雾天环境中鲁棒性的在线测试时自适应框架。FogTTA以RF-DETR作为底层目标检测器，无需源数据或重新训练，即可实现对流式目标域的实时自适应。该框架采用师生设计，已部署的模型作为教师，从弱增强的目标输入中生成伪标签，随后通过非极大值抑制和置信度过……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出FogTTA在线测试时自适应框架，通过师生伪标签机制使基于Transformer的目标检测器无需源数据或重训练即可实时适应雾天场景，显著提升雾天检测的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: FogTTA is an online test-time adaptation framework that uses a teacher-student pseudo-labeling mechanism to enable Transformer-based object detectors to adapt in real time to foggy conditions without source data or retraining, significantly improving detection robustness in fog.
